description: Kreis Herford: Öffentliche Trinkwasserbrunnen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.kreis-herford.de. This dataset contains locations of drinking water wells and dispensers in Herford County. These are usually found in public places and offer a free way to bottle water or drink directly. The data comes from OpenStreetMap and was updated in July 2026. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Herford County: Public drinking water wells" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OpenStreetMap, Trinkwasserbrunnen, Ostwestfalen-Lippe, Bünde, Vlotho, Enger. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
